description: Cost-indexed public prices (prototype). Each configuration's published per-device price is the larger of its list price (price table) and the subscription-policy floor computed from the current network-cost basis. List prices are the minimum; prices rise only when current SUI costs push the floor above list. Customers keep their price for their term; renewals follow the policy's repricing trigger.

sources: Quote basis from docs/business/subscription-example.json: SUI $0.987 (CoinGecko 2026-10-23), Mainnet reference gas price 100 MIST (epoch 1291)
Update with: python3 scripts/cost_indexed_pricing.py --set-basis ... then python3 scripts/subscription_pricing.py --generate-site

scaling: SUI-sensitive cost scales with (current SUI/USD ÷ quote SUI/USD) × (current reference gas price ÷ quote reference gas price). Scaling storage gas with the reference gas price overstates cost, so floors err high. Walrus cost is held at the basis; policy floors stress it separately.
